cohort: The study included 80 women aged 18-35 years, between 13-26 weeks of gestation, all with a prior cesarean section, undergoing mid-trimester pregnancy termination.
finding: Foley catheter combined with misoprostol was more efficient than mifepristone with misoprostol in inducing mid-trimester abortion, especially in women with a previous cesarean section, with a significantly shorter mean induction-to-abortion interval.
